note: What a server sends about a camp of units that belong to no side. Both payloads observed name a camp with nothing credited for it and no time for its return, one of them for a camp that had just filled, so whether it marks a camp emptied is not settled here. The header names no object: it carries zero.

fields.name: killer
fields.note: The champion credited with emptying the camp, or zero for none. Where the camp has no buff side and no line of its own, a client has that champion speak a line for it, whatever speak says.

fields.name: camp
fields.note: Which camp. A client ignores a camp it does not know, but for the timer.

bits.name: speak
bits.note: Set to have the client play the line for a camp revealed or a buff taken, to the client's own side.

bits.name: firstSide
bits.note: A client does not read it.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: A client does not read these.

fields.name: timerKind
fields.note: Which of the client's neutral timers to set: a key into its own table, not a small number. Zero touches no timer.

fields.name: returnsAt
fields.note: The game time, in seconds, when the camp fills again. The largest finite 32-bit float means now.

fields.name: killer
fields.note: The unit credited with emptying it. Zero in everything observed.

fields.name: timerKind
fields.note: Which clock the client shows for it. Zero in everything observed.

fields.name: returnsAt
fields.note: When the camp fills again, in seconds. Zero in everything observed.

bits.name: speak
bits.note: Set where the client says something about it. Set in everything observed.
